welcome:
**Welcome to MIGRA-IA.** Two ways to use it; the first one **needs no API key and costs nothing**.

• **Interactive demo** — here **you** answer. Your equipment is identified against the verified catalog of **30 manufacturers, 130 generations and 469 CPU models**; the questions and their options come from the master questionnaire; the risk engine scores **your** answers; the decision map says what is in order for **your** case and, if migrating is the way, the **50-step** procedure guides you with the target CPU you choose (same brand or another). No language model: same case, same result, every time.

• **API mode · Claude** — type your request and **Claude** opens with your own subscription to solve it (for example, programming in TIA Portal).
err_case_expired: Case not found or session expired. Open a new case.
real_needs_key:
**The «Real case (API)» mode is not enabled on this server.** That mode talks to the Anthropic model, and that needs a paid API key: this is a non-profit academic project, so the public demo runs with no key and at no cost to whoever visits it.

**The «Interactive demo» next to it is not a cut-down version.** It is the real engine ---identification against the catalog, questionnaire, risk scoring, decision map and the 50-step procedure--- working with YOUR answers. The one thing it cannot do is hold a free-form conversation.

If you want the AI mode, install it on your own machine with your own key: it is explained in `INSTALL_GUIDE.md`, inside the repository.
err_no_credential: There is no valid Anthropic credential. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in the .env file (see .env.example).
claude_mode_intro:
**API mode · Claude.** This server has no API key, so the real case is handled by **Claude** with your own subscription, at no extra cost.

Type below what you need (equipment, CPU, TIA Portal version and what the machine must do) and press **Send**. Claude will open in a new tab with your request already written.

For Claude to program directly on your PC:
- Keep the Claude desktop app open, with *Computer use* turned on.
- If Claude opens in the browser, pick your PC in **+ → Devices** before sending.
- Do not use the mouse or keyboard while Claude is working.
placeholder_claude: E.g.: CPU S7-1200 1214C, TIA Portal V19. Program a star-delta starter in LAD for a 20 HP motor...
claude_prompt_header:
Migra IA API mode. Take control of my PC and solve the following in TIA Portal.
Technician's request:
claude_prompt_footer: Compile with no errors, test in PLCSIM if applicable and give me a summary.
claude_opened:
Done: Claude opened in a new tab with your request **and it was also copied to the clipboard**.

• If you see your request typed in Claude, just press **Enter**.
• If Claude opens empty, click the text box, press **Ctrl+V** and then **Enter**.

If no tab opened, check that the browser did not block the pop-up and press **Send** again.
claude_too_long: The request is too long to send through a link (about 1,800 characters max). Shorten it and try again.
